_comment: THE SHARED TRUTH TABLE for 'is this setup tradeable?'.
Two implementations of this rule exist and CANNOT share code, because they
live on opposite sides of a language boundary:
· TypeScript — isTradeableSetup()      lib/jack/handle-score.ts
· Python     — is_tradeable_setup()    pipeline/run_daily.py
This file is what stops them drifting. It is the single source of truth for
the RULE, and both selftests read THIS FILE rather than restating the cases:
· scripts/jack-entry-alert-selftest.ts
· python pipeline/run_daily.py --selftest
Change the rule here and both sides fail until both are updated. Add a case
here and both sides must satisfy it. Neither side can quietly diverge.
THE RULE, in precedence order:
1. tier Q1 or Q2      -> NOT tradeable. The frozen SIZE_MAP maps Q1/Q2 to
skip and jack-state.md is absolute: 'Q1/Q2 are never traded — breakout
or not.' The tier VETOES, so a contradictory bucket cannot override it.
2. bucket 'skip'      -> NOT tradeable.
3. anything else      -> tradeable. Suppression requires POSITIVE evidence
of a skip; an unclassified setup keeps its prior behaviour rather than
silently losing a signal.
`cases` below is the COMPLETE CROSS-PRODUCT of tier {null,Q1..Q5} x bucket
{null,full,half,skip} — 24 rows, nothing implied — followed by normalization
edge cases. The POSITIVE rows (Q3/Q4/Q5 + full/half -> true) are asserted
explicitly and matter most: isTradeableSetup gates the Basket Sizer and the
LIVE display group, so a reorder that broke the positive path would silently
SHRINK the basket rather than fail loudly.
`changedByFix` records whether the 2026-08-24 reorder altered that row. The
order was previously: skip -> false, full/half -> TRUE, then the tier — so
`full/half -> true` short-circuited before the tier was read, and a Q1/Q2
setup carrying a full bucket was reported TRADEABLE, able to raise a PROMOTED
/ ENTRY CONFIRMED alert for a tier that never trades.
EXACTLY 5 rows carry changedByFix=true and every one is tier Q1/Q2 with a
full/half bucket. Both selftests assert that invariant directly, which is the
machine-checked proof that the fix is BEHAVIOUR-NEUTRAL for Q3/Q4/Q5 and
touches nothing on the positive path.
